main.description: One file at a revision: an image, a binary, too large to show, or text, with the ranges its highlighting paints. The bytes themselves are at the repository's raw path. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

errors.description: No such repository, revision, path or record.
errors.name: NotFound

html.description: A Markdown file made into HTML, as a README is.

kind.description: How it is shown: only `text` comes with its text.

ranges.description: The ranges its highlighting paints, encoded as the pages read them.

ref.description: The ref or commit shown, as `ref` named it, less any path.

path.description: A path in the tree, from its root.

ref.description: A branch, a tag or a commit; the default branch if absent. It may run on into the path, as a web address names them: the longest branch or tag that starts it is the ref, and what follows goes before `path`.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

description: One file of a repository at a revision.
